messages:
maria-rt: Quick heads-up — I ran a 2h perf sweep on the continuous-batching window after changing the kernel preference and tightening coalesce params. p95 tail improved but KV hit-rate dipped slightly.
jonathan: can you share the exact diffs you rolled for the test? especially jitter and delay numbers.
maria-rt: sure. changed microbatch_interval_ms 2.0 -> 1.5, coalesce_delay_ms 5 -> 3, jitter=gaussian sigma=0.8, kernel_preference now prefers avx_small_seq for seq<=128.
kevin_s: interesting. smaller windows -> denser batches, but could change prefix alignment and prime patterns. that could explain kv hit down. any cpu/gpu delta?
maria-rt: cpu_util +4% on aggregator hosts, gpu steady. perf-bot reported p95 210ms -> 195ms (-7.1%), kv_hit_rate -2.9%. link: https://prom.redwood/exp/3612
perf-bot: [alert] experiment-3612 rollout metrics posted. p50/p95/p99 and kv hit in dashboard.
jonathan: paste the profiler snippet for tail samples, want to see kernel swap frequency.
maria-rt: top samples from the heavy-tail bucket:
```
43% runtime:avx_small_seq_kernel
24% runtime:kv_lookup
11% runtime:dispatch
9% runtime:quantize_path
6% runtime:waiting:coalesce_timer
```
maria-rt: we saw frequent swaps between avx_small_seq and avx_medium_seq when mid-batch seq exceeded 128, which correlates with higher kv_lookup percent and lower hit locality.
emma: proposal: back off coalesce_delay to 4ms, set microbatch_interval to 1.75ms, and introduce token_budget_target=96 to avoid crossing the 128 boundary mid-batch. also reduce jitter sigma to 0.6. canary at 5% traffic.
kevin_s: +1. token_budget_target should keep most batches below the kernel switch threshold and preserve KV priming. also suggest queue_policy fifo_with_priority for latency routes to avoid head-of-line prefix disruption.
jonathan: agree. also record per-batch seq_len histogram and kernel_swap_rate. add a replay eval that uses the recent regression prompt set.
maria-rt: config I'll deploy to canary:
```
microbatch_interval_ms: 1.75
coalesce_delay_ms: 4
jitter: {type: gaussian, sigma: 0.6}
token_budget_target: 96
queue_policy: fifo_with_priority
kernel_preference: [avx_small_seq, avx_medium_seq]
```
maria-rt: plan: 5% canary for 30m, collect p50/p95/p99, kv_hit_rate, kernel_swap_rate, seq_len_hist, cpu/gpu util, and the regression eval.
perf-bot: [action] scheduled canary rollout at 2026-03-18T15:20Z for experiment-3612-canary.
kevin_s: please add a short smoke test that replays microburst traffic patterns to catch unexpected oscillations.
emma: adding eval harness and a synthetic microburst generator.
jonathan: sound plan. keep notes here and flag if p95 improvement drops or kv hit falls further.
maria-rt: kicking off canary now. will report back in ~30m with metrics snapshot.
kevin_s: :thumbsup:
emma: :rocket:
